description: Get the user's closed trades, newest first: one row per close, with direction (long/short), entry and exit price, size, P&L (net of fees where booked), the return on position size, and when it opened and closed. Use it to review past trades or report on them. Read-only. Pages hold up to `limit` stored records, and a close is stored as an exit record plus the entry record(s) it closed, so a page usually lists about half that many trades: keep paging while hasMore is true. A trade with noExitRecord: true was closed by TradeStaq's reconcile after the exchange position was already gone; it is a real close, but get_performance_metrics leaves it out. For aggregate metrics (ROI, win rate, Sortino) use get_performance_metrics instead.

exchange.description: Optional filter by account instead of exchangeId: an account ID, or a platform or account name as list_exchanges shows it (e.g. "bitget"). Refused when more than one account matches.

exchangeId.description: Optional filter: one exchange account ID from list_exchanges. Omit for all accounts.

limit.description: Number of stored records to read, max 200 (about half as many trades). Defaults to 50.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). Defaults to 1.

symbol.description: Optional filter by trading pair, e.g. "BTC/USDT". Omit for all pairs.

name: get_trade_history
